character: A large multi-peak resort in central Vermont off US Route 4, generally regarded as the largest ski area in the eastern US, and known for aiming at a long season with early openings.
learning: Reference note: the Snowshed slope and the Ramshead base are the usual beginner and family areas. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson programs.

season.typicalText: Opens early-to-mid November and closes in May or early June (official history: 2025-26 Nov 12-May 25; 2024-25 Nov 14-May 11; 2023-24 Nov 3-Jun 1).
season.notes: Killington does not set an opening or closing date ("Unlike most resorts, we don't set an opening date"); winter lift tickets are available starting November 7 (official pages fetched 2026-10-03). OnTheSnow projects 2026-11-11 to 2027-05-24 (third-party projection).
